scoring_method: Masked-token log probability of alternate 6-mer minus reference 6-mer
correction: Arithmetic mean of six phase scores
limitations: ClinVar labels are clinical classifications, not direct molecular-effect measurements
The model is not a validated clinical pathogenicity classifier
Phase averaging is training-free and does not guarantee better clinical discrimination
Shifting windows also changes flanking sequence context
The expected model revision is recorded but not independently verified by this script
